what_this_release_delivers: #187 full-stage game slide deck and unobtrusive top HUD feedback dock: centers the main canvas stage on the game slide deck (Prev/Next slide navigation, Slide 1/2 counter, slide pills for Tetris and Puzzle Bobble, and Arcade Deck showcase cards with Play <Game> action and in-place game switching), while tucking the feedback prompt and navigation controls into a compact top HUD bar

#174 adoption of v0.1.0-alpha.33 YOLO Dev request templates: maps the guided composer's three intents onto yolo.feedback@1.0.0, yolo.feature@1.0.0, and yolo.bug@1.0.0, adds toYoloRequestPayload and parseRequestTemplate (retaining backward compatibility with blankcanvas.*@1 and plain-text issues), and installs .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/yolo.{feedback,feature,bug,question}@1.0.0.yml
